about.title: E uiga ki
about.intro: {project} se platform fou ki te fakatasi o faila peer-to-peer, ne fakatu i luga i te tekonolosi modern decentralized. E fakatasi se interface faigofie ki se architecture decentralized atoa, e fakamautinoa te fakatasi o faila e saogalemu kae mafai o talitonu i ei e seai se manakoga ki se pulega tukufakatasi. Te galuega tenei se open source, ne tuku atu i lalo o te {license}.

decentralized.title: Te netiueka decentralized atoa
decentralized.description: E seai se server tukufakatasi, e seai se tasi tulafono e mafai o pala. E maua kae sisi mai ne tagata fakaaoga te tulaga tonu mai te tasi ki te isi, e seai se talitonuga ki se index tukufakatasi, tracker, io me se database.

accessControl.title: Te pulega faka-fakatasi
accessControl.description: E mafai e nisi tagata o fakatu tana netiueka tonu mo ana tulafono tonu fakatasi. I loto i te netiueka takitasi, ko tulaga o tagata fakaaoga e fakamatala mai: te pule, te administrator, te tagata fakasalalau, te moderator, mo te tagata mulimuli. E maua e koe se pulega faka-fakatasi i ai ko se tagata e mafai o fakasalalau, moderate, mo o sisi mai te tulaga.

ui.title: Se interface lelei
ui.description: Se interface mama mo tonuga vave o te media center, ne fakatu mo desktop, televise, mo mobile platforms. E faigofie te seleseleaga i te keyboard, ratoura, gamepad, io me te puleaga mamao. E mafai e tagata fakaaoga maualuluga o fakaaoga te software pelā mo se headless server o tulaga ki te command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Te tulaga o tulaga e mafai e te tagata o faitau
dataFormat.description: Te tulaga LISH ne fakatu i luga o JSON, e fakaufamoesega o fakatu, faitau, mo malamalama. Fakatasi atu te tulaga o koe ki metadata mama mo manino, e mafai e nisi tagata o silasila lelei.

security.title: Te tonuga mo te saogalemu
security.description: Ko fakafesootaiga peer-to-peer katoa e encrypted, e fakamautinoa te tulaga o koe e tonu i te tulaga o te alualu. E mafai e tagata fakaaoga o lafi i tafatafa o se VPN ki te anonymity malosi atu. {project} e fakatauloto atu te tonuga ona mai tana fakatuga.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Te software e maua mo Windows, Linux, mo macOS. Fakaaoga i te platform e manako koe.

download.description: Maua {project} mo to platform. Ko sisi mai katoa e seai se totogi mo open source.
